reason=infra_enospc_bash_unavailable The Bash tool was unavailable for this entire attempt: every invocation (including from a freshly-spawned sub-agent, and including trivial commands like `echo x` or `df -h /tmp`) failed at the tool-infrastructure level with: ENOSPC: no space left on device, open '/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/*.output' This happened on ~15 separate attempts across the full session, both direct and via a fresh Agent sub-process, so it is not a transient single-command failure — the harness cannot even persist its own command-output capture file for this session/worktree right now. Work completed before hitting the blocker (research only, no code changes): - Read cli/internal/agent/execute_bead_land.go end to end. Identified the ROOT CAUSE call site: within waitForEmptyGitIndex (execute_bead_land.go, the "Real staged work is committed" fallback that calls checkpointLandingWorktreeLocalChanges unconditionally after checkpointOrphanedExecutionEvidence/unstageOrphanedExecutionEvidence both decline to act on a mixed/foreign staged set), and the general-purpose checkpointLandingWorktreeLocalChanges call inside landLocked() (the unconditional "pre-land <targetRef>" checkpoint taken under the main git lock before the ref is advanced). - Read cli/internal/agent/execute_bead_report.go: confirmed classifyLandCoordinationAction / allGeneratedLandCoordinationPaths already distinguish "all-generated-path" staged sets (retry) from sets containing a genuine foreign path (operator attention) for the "staged changes after waiting" error text — the wiring this bead needs to reuse/extend already exists on the reporting side. - Read cli/internal/agent/execute_bead_land_test.go: found that TestLand_StagedOperatorFilesBlockLanding, TestLand_DirtyProjectRootDoesNotBlockSuccessfulLand, and TestLand_SyncDeferredWhenOperatorCheckoutDirtyOverlap currently assert the OPPOSITE of this bead's contract — they assert that a staged/dirty non-evidence path (e.g. operator.txt, README.md) IS silently checkpoint-committed and does NOT block landing (this is the "never reset or refuse operator changes" behavior from commit 1856c8e0c / ddx-15c7a79a). Implementing this bead's hard-stop correctly will require updating those three tests' expectations in the same commit, not just adding the new TestLandAdvancer_HardStopsOnForeignDirtyPaths test — otherwise the suite will not be green (AC 4 requires the full ./internal/agent/... suite to pass). No source or test files were modified. No commit was created. This bead should be retried once the environment's /tmp (or the tool harness's per-session output-capture quota) has free space again; at that point re-derive the fix from the analysis above rather than re-reading the whole file from scratch.
suggested_action=retry with a smart agent

no_changes
rationale: status: open
reason: infra_enospc_bash_unavailable

The Bash tool was unavailable for this entire attempt: every invocation
(including from a freshly-spawned sub-agent, and including trivial commands
like `echo x` or `df -h /tmp`) failed at the tool-infrastructure level with:

  ENOSPC: no space left on device, open '/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/*.output'

This happened on ~15 separate attempts across the full session, both direct
and via a fresh Agent sub-process, so it is not a transient single-command
failure — the harness cannot even persist its own command-output capture
file for this session/worktree right now.

Work completed before hitting the blocker (research only, no code changes):
- Read cli/internal/agent/execute_bead_land.go end to end. Identified the
  ROOT CAUSE call site: within waitForEmptyGitIndex (execute_bead_land.go,
  the "Real staged work is committed" fallback that calls
  checkpointLandingWorktreeLocalChanges unconditionally after
  checkpointOrphanedExecutionEvidence/unstageOrphanedExecutionEvidence both
  decline to act on a mixed/foreign staged set), and the general-purpose
  checkpointLandingWorktreeLocalChanges call inside landLocked() (the
  unconditional "pre-land <targetRef>" checkpoint taken under the main git
  lock before the ref is advanced).
- Read cli/internal/agent/execute_bead_report.go: confirmed
  classifyLandCoordinationAction / allGeneratedLandCoordinationPaths already
  distinguish "all-generated-path" staged sets (retry) from sets containing
  a genuine foreign path (operator attention) for the "staged changes after
  waiting" error text — the wiring this bead needs to reuse/extend already
  exists on the reporting side.
- Read cli/internal/agent/execute_bead_land_test.go: found that
  TestLand_StagedOperatorFilesBlockLanding,
  TestLand_DirtyProjectRootDoesNotBlockSuccessfulLand, and
  TestLand_SyncDeferredWhenOperatorCheckoutDirtyOverlap currently assert the
  OPPOSITE of this bead's contract — they assert that a staged/dirty
  non-evidence path (e.g. operator.txt, README.md) IS silently
  checkpoint-committed and does NOT block landing (this is the
  "never reset or refuse operator changes" behavior from commit 1856c8e0c /
  ddx-15c7a79a). Implementing this bead's hard-stop correctly will require
  updating those three tests' expectations in the same commit, not just
  adding the new TestLandAdvancer_HardStopsOnForeignDirtyPaths test —
  otherwise the suite will not be green (AC 4 requires the full
  ./internal/agent/... suite to pass).

No source or test files were modified. No commit was created.

This bead should be retried once the environment's /tmp (or the tool
harness's per-session output-capture quota) has free space again; at that
point re-derive the fix from the analysis above rather than re-reading the
whole file from scratch.
